text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. We put the 
finishing 
touches right here, where we spent our 
time surviving.
choice_data_list: Tact, give me one full run.
Tact, give me one full run.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhhhh...!!

She tears effortlessly across the sandy 
beach with sheer power. 
Her running was already magnificent, but 
after this summer 
camp... it has unquestionably been honed 
to a razor edge!
choice_data_list: (Alright, with this, the Triple Tiara is—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Tore-san?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Mejiro Ramonu...! 
What brings you here?

She is Mejiro Ramonu. A member of the 
Mejiro family 
renowned throughout the racing world—and 
the very 
first Triple Tiara horsegirl in history.

Mejiro Ramonu's striking presence sends a 
sudden chill 
of tension through the air... But this 
might be a golden opportunity.

Before challenging the final crown, 
perhaps we could receive 
some advice from her. Daring Tact seemed 
to share the exact 
same thought—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Um, Mejiro Ramonu. 
May I ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To achieve the Triple Tiara... 
what do you think was the single 
most important thing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: To love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The beginning of this path 
is pure, untainted love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All who walk this path 
cannot help but love something...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...By that, do you mean—

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu, our boat will be arriving 
shortly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Very well.

...There must be a Mejiro family retreat 
nearby. 
Daring Tact and I quietly watched her 
receding figure 
for a while...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: What is it... that I love, I wonder?

While cleaning up our makeshift gear 
crafted from nature 
and packing our bags... Daring Tact 
suddenly murmured to herself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If everyone who captures the Triple Tiara 
always loves something without fail... 
then what about me...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list: You love your hometown, don't you?
You love your hometown, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hehe! 
Yes, without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yet, I feel like it's not just that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because right now... I want to brighten 
the hearts of people beyond Hidaka, too.
choice_data_list: The hometown you love is expanding, then.
The hometown you love is expanding, then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That is... 
such a wonderful way to put it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Right!

We row the raft with refreshed, lighter 
bodies. 
Every trip was grueling, but... 
knowing this is the last one feels 
strangely bittersweet.
choice_data_list:
Let's put everything we've got into 
rowing...!

Let's put everything we've got into 
rowing...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
Haaaaahhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
We set a new personal best! 
—On the raft, that is!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't scare me like that... 
I thought you beat a record on the track, 
but on a raft?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding. 
It doesn't look like you were slacking 
off, either.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Your whole vibe has changed. 
Did you go through some hardcore survival 
training out there?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And on top of that... 
I found something.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A new drive to push even harder. 
In the Shuka Sho, 
I will show you more than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, you just gave me chills. 
Seems like you've already stepped into the 
role 
of a Triple Tiara horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't let you have it that easy. 
In any good sports drama, 
turning the tables from here is where it 
gets thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It seems we are both fully motivated. 
May the best runner win.

And so, our fiery summer camp came to an 
end—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I can't sleep...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I really pushed myself at summer camp, 
after all. 
Maybe getting some fresh air will help...)

Oh? 
Daring Tact!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing up at this hour? 
...Though I guess I can't really talk 
either.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(What a strange day. 
To run into two Triple Tiara horsegirls 
completely by chance...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(If Mejiro Ramonu was the very first, then 
Almond Eye 
is the most recent Triple Tiara horsegirl. 
...Yet, if I win the Shuka Sho—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, Almond Eye... were you out running? 
Even though training camp just ended?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I know, right! But I just couldn't resist 
running. 
There's such a long break until my next 
race... 
It's driving me crazy!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You truly love to run, don't you? 
...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, Almond Eye... 
what is it that you love?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me for such an odd question. 
The truth is, earlier today—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Victory.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I love victory.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...! 
This... sheer intensity—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You've got a big race coming up soon, 
don't you, Daring Tact? 
Make sure you don't catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching. 
...See ya!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: (That feeling just now... what was that—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Achoo.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(...I should head back inside. 
The breeze is carrying the chill of 
autumn—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho is right around the corner—
